What you'll do

•
Team Leadership & Development: Lead and mentor a team spanning GTM strategy, planning, and variable compensation-setting clear objectives, running performance management, and driving hiring.

•
GTM Strategy, Planning & Execution: Run the end-to-end annual and in-year GTM planning cycles. •
Capacity, Coverage & Segmentation Modeling: Design and optimize segmentation, coverage, and headcount models across enterprise, commercial, and self-service motions. Pressure-test cross-functional capacity plans across SE, CS, and PS to ensure full revenue factory alignment.

Cross-Functional & Strategic Advisory: Serve as the GTM Strategy representative on the Pricing Council to model revenue/attainment impacts. Partner with field ops on QBR/executive materials and apply practical AI use cases to elevate team productivity.

Sprout Social is looking for an analytically rigorous, growth-minded planning leader who builds models that hold up under pressure-and can explain them clearly to senior stakeholders. The minimum qualifications for this role include:

• 10-12+ years of experience in GTM strategy, revenue operations, or management consulting within B2B SaaS/enterprise tech, including 3+ years managing and developing teams.

• Proven track record leading end-to-end GTM planning, including quota design, territory allocation, TAM/SAM sizing, headcount capacity modeling, and sales segmentation at scale.
